gloss: to obtain; to get hold of; to acquire

definitions.gloss: to obtain; to get hold of; to acquire
definitions.explanation: To get something into one's possession, often after effort or good luck: a ticket, a rare item, a piece of information, a qualification. Literally 'to put into the hand.' The intransitive pair {手|て}に{入|はい}る means to come into one's hands or to be obtainable.

examples.japanese: ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手|て}に{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I finally got hold of a ticket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手|て}に{入|い}れた。
examples.english: After years of effort she obtained her license to practice law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手|て}に{入|い}れる⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{古本屋|ふるほんや}→古本屋：16329_furuhonya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}った→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: To get hold of the old map, he went around secondhand bookshops all over the country.

notes:
Literally 'to put into one's hand.' The pair is ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: something comes into one's hands or is available (⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ — easy to get). Note the two readings of the same kanji: ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ but ⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手|て}に{入|い}れる: to obtain ~
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手|て}に{入|い}れる: to get information
- {手|て}に{入|い}れにくい: hard to come by

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy — only by purchase
- ⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to gain, to obtain — formal and abstract
- ⟦{入手|にゅうしゅ}→入手：11636_nyuushu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to acquire — the formal Sino-Japanese equivalent
